children: was upgraded to Overweight from Underweight by JPMorgan, which raised its price target to $65 from $46. The firm said IREN is establishing itself as a top tier neocloud provider on the back of its partnership with Nvidia
, with customer signings gaining pace. IREN shares were down 3.83% intraday.

Industry rates have moved up substantially from $10 to $15 per watt to $15 to $20 and higher, depending on delivery, GPU generation and contract length. JPMorgan expects IREN's roughly 0.5 gigawatt expansion in 2027 to be signed at materially higher prices than past deals struck at $12 to $15 per watt. IREN has raised its expected annual recurring revenue for the end of calendar 2026 to $4.0 billion from $3.4 billion last November, against $1 billion of operating ARR today.
IREN has handed over the first of four 50 megawatt buildings under its Microsoft

contract, with the remaining 150 megawatts due by the end of calendar 2026. Alongside Microsoft and Nvidia, it has signed Prometheus, Figure AI, Perplexity, Together AI, Fluidstack, Cohere and others, plus a multi-year contract with an unnamed frontier AI lab. JPMorgan flags the Texas interconnection audit as a near-term risk to the 2027 pipeline.

title: IREN Draws a Two-Notch Upgrade on Neocloud Pricing
